_comment: Register these as Custom Tools in VAPI (Dashboard > Tools, or via API). Set each tool's server.url to https://<your-host>/vapi/tool-calls. The assistant calls them; your server replies with {"results":[{"toolCallId","result"}]}.

function.name: find_service_slots
function.description: Find open service-department appointment times. Use when the caller wants to know what's available but hasn't named an exact time.

date.description: Optional preferred day in YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to search the next 7 days.

function.name: check_service_availability
function.description: Check whether a specific date and time is open for a given service. Use when the caller names an exact time.

time.description: Time in 24h HH:MM, dealer local time.

function.name: book_service_appointment
function.description: Book a confirmed service appointment. Only call after the caller has agreed to a specific time and given their name and phone number.

time.description: Time in 24h HH:MM, dealer local time.

notes.description: Anything the caller mentioned about the problem.

function.name: request_human_advisor
function.description: Hand the call to a live service advisor. Call this when the caller asks for a person, sounds distressed, or the request is beyond scheduling.
